messages:
jon: FYI — Canary rollout of fused-attn-v2 shows p95/p99 regression on short sequences. Perf link: https://go/redux/prof/3634

tara: timeline? batching config changed?

jon: kernel swap only. batching was micro_window_ms=1.2, coalesce_delay_ms=0.6, jitter=uniform(0,0.2), token_budget=2048. KV miss rate up ~12% and median batch size dropped 10-25% during spikes.

sam: new kernel might shift enqueue latency distribution by ~0.4ms at p95. Requests that used to fall into boundary now slip to next window -> coalescing worsens.

iris: I plotted arrival vs emit heatmap. Workers align on micro-window edges; the slippage causes synchronized larger batches hitting same shard and priming evictions.

tara: current config:
```
batch:
  micro_window_ms: 1.2
  coalesce_delay_ms: 0.6
  jitter: uniform(0,0.2)
  token_budget: 2048
```

sam: propose two probes: 1) widen micro_window to 2.2ms 2) increase jitter amplitude (or per-worker phase-offset) to de-synchronize edges.

jon: quick 10m canary: micro_window=2.2ms + jitter uniform(0,1.0) -> median batch size +18%, p99 back to baseline, KV miss down ~9%, CPU +3%.

iris: tried per-worker random phase offset in [0,micro_window). Similar improvement to widening but lower CPU delta.

tara: what's the token_budget behavior if windows widen? risk of token aggregate > token_budget.

jon: with token_budget=2048 we were safe for this traffic mix. For long-streaming requests we must test token_budget=4096 to avoid hitting budget-induced splits.

sam: long-term: adapt batching scheduler to be budget-aware: emit when token_budget threshold reached even if window not elapsed; also consider latency-prioritized emits for short requests.

ops-bot: deploy plan acknowledged. Canary hosts tagged rtf-canary-36. Revert docs: /infra/playbooks/kernel-rollback.md :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll run 2h experiment at 03:30 UTC with micro_window=2.2ms + per-worker phase randomization. Rollback ready.

jon: will gather flamegraphs, KV priming traces, and evictions. I'll post perf diffs after the run.

sam: adding checklist to perf board and will capture token budget histograms and per-batch token counts.

tara: thanks everyone. If results hold, RFC to update default micro_window to 2.2ms with phase-randomization and keep fused-attn-v2.

jon: ack — will follow up with final artifacts.
